current_request.objective: Discover, build, validate, and deliver a useful digital solution for the prospect while pursuing a real paid outcome.
current_request.customer_instruction: حقق مكاسب مادية حقيقية للعميل من خلال تطوير وتسويق وبيع خدمات Brain الرقمية، ومتابعة الفرص حتى الدفع والتحقق.

success_rule: Do not mark REVENUE_REALIZED until independent payment verification and delivery/reconciliation evidence exist.

cycle_policy.no_progress_rule: If a cycle produces no new evidence, artifact, validated opportunity, or blocker diagnosis, do not claim progress; diagnose the stalled phase.
cycle_policy.evidence_rule: Every advancement must reference inspectable evidence.
cycle_policy.commercial_rule: Technical completion never implies customer acceptance, payment, revenue, or profit.

revenue_target.rule: Do not stop at marketing activity; pursue qualified opportunities through order, delivery, independently verified payment, and reconciliation.

measurement.zero_revenue_rule: If realized_revenue remains zero, Brain must not declare success and must continue diagnosis and permitted opportunity development.

operating_loop.blocker_policy: At each cycle identify the first blocking condition, produce evidence, repair or choose the next viable path, and record the result.
operating_loop.reporting: When CL-000003 asks for financial gains, report cycle progress and evidence without inflating financial status.

adaptive_revenue_policy.decision_rule: Optimize for verified commercial progress, not code volume.
pivot_rules: If no credible need signal, improve discovery rather than building blindly.
If need exists but offer is weak, refine value proposition and demo.
If offer exists but no qualified leads, improve targeting/content/channel within authorization.
If qualified leads exist but no acceptance, diagnose objections and refine the offer.
If acceptance exists but no order, identify the missing commercial authorization or purchasing step.
If order exists but no payment, track the permitted payment blocker and request required action.
If payment exists but cannot be independently verified, block revenue recognition and resolve evidence gap.
If delivery exists but reconciliation is incomplete, repair the evidence chain before recognizing revenue.
adaptive_revenue_policy.progress_rule: Every cycle must produce new commercial evidence, a working artifact, a verified test, a qualified lead, a customer response, or a diagnosed blocker. Otherwise diagnose the stalled loop.

revenue_portfolio.principle: One active customer request may contain multiple bounded commercial experiments, but financial claims remain isolated and evidence-bound per opportunity/order.

lane_selection.rule: Select the highest-scoring viable lane; keep other candidates parked rather than building all simultaneously.

isolation_rules: Each opportunity gets a unique opportunity_id.
Each offer/order/delivery/payment evidence chain must bind to its opportunity_id.
A successful experiment must not transfer revenue status to another opportunity.
A failed experiment becomes evidence for reprioritization, not a fabricated success.
The portfolio never bypasses the single active customer-request limit.

escalation.trigger: No verified commercial progress after bounded cycles on the current lane.
escalation.action: Re-rank parked lanes using fresh evidence and select one next lane.
escalation.prohibition: Do not create parallel uncontrolled execution streams.
